BiblicalUsage: Zeker is a Gibeonite named once in the genealogy of Benjamin, in the family of Jeiel the father of Gibeon. The King James spells his name Zacher, and the same man is listed among the sons of the house that lived at Gibeon.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a single verse is enough to keep a man remembered, and Zacher's name stands because his family kept its place among Benjamin's sons.
